about: This lesson carries no number and no outside claim. It matches its source's structure (research/PROVEN.md row 3: roof close-ups, one question, no answer). Everything on screen is ours and drawn: the roof, its round marks and loose granules, the worn shingles, the dented vent, the gutter with no dent, the homeowner. All of it is labeled EXAMPLE. The video never says which it is, and never says what any mark proves.

example.what: ours: a drawn roof with round marks the size of a dime and granules gone, the whole roof worn, a dent in the vent and none in the gutter; a homeowner who says it's hail. No verdict is given.
